text.en:
The name of Balasiao Elementary School, in Barangay Balasiao, Municipality of Kiblawan,
Province of Davao del Sur, is changed to Isabelo Calma, Sr. Elementary School.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: April 27, 1984
